semiconductor_relevance: High — Toho Koki Seisakusho specializes in advanced semiconductor materials and processing technologies critical for substrate manufacturing.
summary: Toho Koki Seisakusho Co., Ltd. develops and commercializes advanced semiconductor materials and processing technologies, including high-quality AlN templates and SiC wafers. Their innovative planarization technology and CMP pad processing equipment support the semiconductor manufacturing process, contributing to improved device performance and yield.
capabilities: Manufacture of high-quality AlN templates for LEDs
Production of SiC wafers using CARE planarization technology
Bonded SiC substrates with high quality and low cost

regional_presence.Japan: The company collaborates with universities and research institutes in Japan for technology development.
